title: APIs and services
why: AI features ship as services. You'll wrap every model call in an API with validated inputs and outputs, and this is the shape of almost every take-home.
outcomes: Explain HTTP methods, status codes and JSON bodies
Build a FastAPI service with Pydantic request and response models
Use async endpoints so slow model calls don't block
Manage settings and secrets through environment variables
lessons: HTTP: methods, status codes, headers and JSON bodies
FastAPI tutorial: path, query and body parameters
Pydantic models for request and response validation
Async endpoints that call external APIs without blocking
Settings and secrets with pydantic-settings and .env
Test the API with pytest and TestClient; explore it in Bruno
resources: Read in order, build your own API alongside
Python API Development: Comprehensive Course for Beginners
A long FastAPI build from first route to database and deployment. Watch the first few hours, then dip in.
method: Follow the FastAPI tutorial in order, but build your own API next to it rather than copying the tutorial's. Every endpoint gets a test the same day it's written.
build: A /summarise endpoint that takes text, calls an LLM (or Ollama) and returns validated JSON with a summary and key points.

quiz.q: Which status code means a resource was created?
What happens when a request body fails a FastAPI Pydantic model?
o: FastAPI returns a 422 with details of what failed
The bad fields are dropped silently
quiz.e: Validation errors return 422 Unprocessable Entity with field-level messages.

quiz.q: When is async def worth it in an endpoint?
o: When the endpoint waits on I/O such as an LLM API call
quiz.e: Async lets the server handle other requests while one waits on the network.

quiz.q: Which method should never change data on the server?
quiz.e: GET is safe and idempotent; it reads only.

quiz.q: Where does the API key go when the service is deployed?
o: In the platform's environment variables or secret store
quiz.e: Secrets are injected at runtime by the platform, never baked into images or code.
